views.observations: Open two-half stepped bowl, low brick exterior and localized west gate remain legible; field is preview stage only.
Open bowl and distinct short-end openings visible; only west pavilion has a local canopy; no whole-stadium roof.
East source projection remains a bounded unroofed platform, separate from the detailed west special stand; no stand-body return-wall crossing visible.
Two original end breaks remain open beneath gate lintels; narrow west front terrace connects facade/core; large field void retained.
Three large deep outside arches with smaller recessed rear gates; four vertical piers with narrow windows and exactlytwo simplified ding urns; inscriptions intentionally blank.

Continuous raised front terrace links front parapet and seat core, with three closed recessed inner arches below; horizontal upper room, muted red seats, two towers, side stairs and local canopy remain distinct.
South central rectangular portal visibly open to preview ground beyond; side arches are bounded recesses and four plain blocks remain distinct from the simpler north gate.

remaining_bounded_simplifications: All elevations and hidden structural links are estimated, not current measured survey.
North wing and other coarse-source plan differences are retained in mapping contract, not asserted to be real courtyards.
Blank inscription boards, simplified stone courses/eaves/ding; no photographs embedded.
Short-end direction inferred from photo context and map axes; incomplete historical precinct reconstruction.
